data.fund_name: Motilal Oswal Nifty G Sec May 2029 Index Fund
data.fund_type: An open-ended target maturity index fund replicating / tracking the Nifty G-sec May 2029 Index. (A Relatively High Interest Rate Risk and Relatively Low Credit Risk).
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to seek returns corresponding to total returns of securities as represented by the Nifty G-sec May 2029 Index, subject to tracking error. However, there can be no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme would be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Constituents of Nifty G-sec May 2029 Index 95% - 100%, Liquid schemes/ debt schemes, debt and/or money market instruments 0%-5%
